legacy_migration.trigger: A locked original script requires a two-person interior exchange to move from entry/standing routes into stable seated zones, and audience tracking of that change is materially necessary
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Use an initial detail/single progression plus one sustained room-readable movement interval, then make the two final seat anchors explicit before dense alternation; do not derive argument, relationship or emotion from this source
legacy_migration.coverage: project-defined origin state -> readable route interval -> explicit final-anchor relation -> locked anchor coverage
legacy_migration.blocking: Assign project-original subject_id, origin_zone_id, route_id and final_anchor_id values; preserve each route endpoint and the resulting screen-side relation
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Allow the geometry shot to outlast nearby singles only until routes and final zones are readable; source durations are evidence statistics, not timings to copy
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK; no dialogue, silence, overlap, ambience, score, off-screen cue or sound-led cut is prescribed
legacy_migration.applicability: Two-person interiors where a locked script makes the transition into stable conversation positions visually necessary
